syntax.suffix_boundary: One adjacent X/x or B/b suffix; suffix is not accepted as a prefix of a longer symbol.
syntax.hex_semantics: ASCII hex digits, ASCII blanks at byte boundaries, odd first nibble gets a leading zero, empty allowed, raw bytes preserved.
syntax.binary_semantics: Only 0/1, ASCII blanks at nibble or byte boundaries after left alignment, leading zero bits pad to whole bytes, empty allowed, most-significant bit first.
syntax.limit_note: IBM documents a 250-byte packed maximum for hex. The same deterministic limit is a guideXOS choice for binary.

lexer_parser.lexer: String scanner recognizes eligible adjacent suffixes after closing quote; validates payload and grouping without allocation; preserves token span and never consumes the following token.
lexer_parser.parser: Uses existing TOKEN_HEX_STRING/TOKEN_BINARY_STRING and literal grammar; operator precedence, implicit/explicit concatenation and quoted function-name handling preserved.
lexer_parser.vm_value: Existing constant decoder packs into length-bearing binary-safe RexxValue strings, including NUL and high-bit bytes.
lexer_parser.normal_string_behavior: Existing quoting and doubled-quote behavior retained.
lexer_parser.syntax_error_source_location: Opening quote location retained for token errors.
lexer_parser.resource_behavior: Over-250 packed-byte suffix literal rejected deterministically in lexer.
